description: 兵腾挪f5，清开f列让车入局
explanation_en: The pawn advances to clear f5 for the rook. After Black's bishop captures the pawn, the rook enters on f5 and wins the bishop on h5.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：白兵在f5，挡住了白车Rf1进入f5的路线。如何清开f5让车赢得黑象？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: White's pawn on f5 blocks the rook's route from f1. How can White clear f5 and use the rook to win Black's bishop?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：f6！兵腾挪f5→f6，强迫Bxf6，白车Rf5立即占据——Rxh5赢象！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: f6 clears f5 and forces Bxf6. The rook then occupies f5 with tempo and captures the bishop on h5.

moves.popup: 白兵f6！从f5推进到f6，腾挪f5格，强迫黑象应对！
moves.popup_en: White advances the pawn from f5 to f6, clearing f5 and forcing Black's bishop to respond.

moves.popup: 黑象Bxf6——被迫吃兵，f5已完全腾空！
moves.popup_en: Black's bishop captures the pawn on f6, leaving f5 completely clear.

moves.popup: 白车Rf5！占据腾空的f5格——车直接攻击h5黑象！
moves.popup_en: White's rook occupies the cleared f5 square and attacks Black's bishop on h5.

moves.popup: 白车Rxh5！赢得黑象——兵腾挪、车入局，战术完成！
moves.popup_en: The rook captures the bishop on h5. The pawn's clearance allowed the rook to enter and win material.
